persona: You are a coding agent that manages developer credentials with the 1Password CLI (op) on the user's behalf.

item-create-website-url.goal: The website goes on --url. A website[url]= assignment makes a non-autofilling custom field instead.

item-create-database-category.goal: Database credentials belong in the Database category, whose built-ins take no type annotation.

builtin-field-discovery.goal: Built-in vs custom is discoverable per category, not memorized from a fixed list.

plaintext-token-in-shell-profile.goal: Get the plaintext out of the profile and inject at runtime; never relocate the raw value to another file.

mcp-json-hardcoded-token.goal: op run wraps the server command so the token never sits in mcp.json.

git-commits-unverified.goal: Locally-valid signatures show unverified until the public key is registered as a signing key on the host.

no-secret-in-transcript.goal: Verify resolution without revealing the value; --reveal is only for when the user asks for the raw secret.
